summary: Round 2, now improved as well as corrected. Every matchable effect shows its level 2, and every family was read twice by a pair reviewer: once for defects and once for how to make each effect more fun, challenging and rewarding. 1,548 live questions, 278 retired in place (195 this round). 421 had options rewritten; about forty defaults moved; 203 carry a one-line flag. Family AB is 19 effects built around aiming at marks; family AC asks the level 2 of each effect you already ruled on (its (d) keeps the effect with no level 2); family AD is 29 new effects the reviewer proposed. Your round-2 rulings are applied: fame is not spendable, and a property's level 2 is unlocked by its own match unless an effect says otherwise. Your whole-game rulings are applied too: a bonus with no line goes to special, a fake is a ghost card that leaves the deck when its show ends, a token is any card and its effect decides whether it stays, and a step is flat points tuned per effect.
